name: PBQ NYC Spring 2023
information: # Please Be Quiet! Most of the events at this competition are blindfolded events, which require significant levels of concentration, focus, and practice. All attendees, including guests, are expected to remain silent during these events while in the competition room. There will be areas outside of the venue room where competitors and guests can talk at a normal volume. ### Note for new competitors: Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) and/or Clock, this might not be the best experience for new competitors and their guests. Also note that due to the venue space, this may not be the best competition for spectators. Please consider registering for another competition if this one isn't for you.
